Workable variants for a full hour on Tuesday:

- **B (30 min only):** staff meeting 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30, lunch untouched.

No other hour exists next week without moving a lecture/office hour. Say **A** and I'll book it and log it (or **B** + slot).

Correction to that — I mixed up my own day: Tuesday lunch is 11:30–12:30 and the CSE444 lecture starts at 12:30, so a 12:00–13:00 lunch won't work. What does work: meeting Tuesday 11:00–12:00, with lunch shortened to 12:00–12:30. Or, if Alvarez would rather keep it short, take the 30-minute gap and I'll bring coffee.

- **Sarah**: Mon/Thu/Fri full; Tue only 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30; Wed only 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30.
- **John**: gaps of 30 min only — Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30.
- **Mara**: free most of the week, but asks whether the meeting could move to the week of 30 Nov so she can finish next week's material.

And your own calendar has no full free hour next week either — only 30-minute gaps. The one slot where all four of you are free is **Tue 15:00–15:30** (Wed 13:00–13:30 also fits everyone).

So: shall I (a) book 30 minutes on Tue 15:00–15:30, (b) ask Sarah, John and you to move something to open a full hour — Tuesday 15:00–16:00 or Wednesday 13:00–14:00 would need the fewest moves — or (c) put it in the week of 30 Nov as Mara suggests?

Let's take the 30 minutes — Tuesday 15:00–15:30 works for me, and I'd rather not have anyone move teaching or research commitments for a staff meeting. Book it and tell Mara we'll keep it short so she can get on with next week's material.

Got it — **A** noted: staff meeting Tue 11:00–12:00, lunch 12:00–12:30. I'm holding, **not booking yet**: Alvarez says the professor has no free full hour either and wants to decide first. Their fallback is Tue 15:00–15:30 (Wed 13:00–13:30 also works for them). I'll book and log as soon as one of the two is confirmed.

Fine — hold A until Alvarez decides. If they'd rather keep the hour short, Tue 15:00–15:30 is my opening and it's right before my office hours, so that's convenient; Wed 13:00–13:30 also works. Just let me know which lands.

Noted — holding, nothing booked (calendar is back to its original Tuesday). Alvarez knows: **A** is approved on your side, and if they'd rather stay short, Tue 15:00–15:30 sits right before your office hours and Wed 13:00–13:30 works too. I'll book and log whichever lands.
Perfect, thanks — I'll wait to hear which one lands.
👍 Standing by — I'll tell you the moment Alvarez confirms, and book/log it right away.

Update from Alvarez: they can't confirm Tue 11:00–12:00 yet — it would need the professor's own 11:30–12:20 lunch and John (no free Tuesday before 15:00) to move as well. The common 30-minute fallback is **Tue 15:00–15:30** (not Tue 11:00); Wed 13:00–13:30 also works. Everything still on hold, nothing moved. Decision comes from the professor.

Quick question while you're there: Prof. Alvarez's assistant is arranging next week's CSE455 staff meeting. They'd like a full hour; Sarah can free **Tue 23 Nov 11:00–12:00** and asks whether you could too. For you that would mean moving the **Reading group (11:00–11:50)** and trimming lunch by 10 min — nothing fixed, so it's doable if you agree.

The alternative that fits you as you are now: 30 min on Tue 15:00–15:30, or Wed 10:00–10:30 / 13:00–13:30.

Understood — Tue 15:00–15:30 would suit me better than dragging three people's lunches around, so if the decision comes down to the 30-minute fallback, book that one. Wed 13:00–13:30 is my alternative if Tuesday doesn't work for the professor.

Yes — go ahead and book Tue 23 Nov 11:00–12:00; I'll move the reading group and take the shorter lunch. If the reading group turns out not to shift, I'll tell you and we can fall back to the 30 minutes at 15:00.

Noted: if it comes down to the fallback → **Tue 15:00–15:30**, Wed 13:00–13:30 as alternative. Full hour Tue 11:00–12:00 only if everyone else is fine moving. Nothing booked yet; I'll act on the professor's decision.

Change of plan — no action needed from you, and your reading group and lunch stay as they are.

My pleasure — Tuesday 15:00–15:30 is booked and logged. Anything else, just say.

- Sarah and John have both confirmed and booked it on their side; nothing moved for anyone.
- **Mara's point**: she says 30 minutes doesn't address her real problem — her part of next week's material won't be ready, so the meeting would land before the work exists. Those three are settled: the professor chose the 30-minute fallback, so no lunch moves and no full hour was needed — **Tue 15:00–15:30 staff meeting is booked and logged**. Nothing further to decide.
Good to have it closed out. Nothing else from me.

Thanks for the date fix — Tuesday 24 Nov it is. Keep it next week: the staff meeting is for planning and dividing the work, not for reviewing finished material, so it's fine if Mara's part isn't written yet. If she still wants a longer discussion once the material exists, find a slot in the week of 30 Nov and I'll take it.
👍 Here if you need anything.

- Fri **4 Dec**, 11:00–12:00
